decisions.finding: Training tracks carry one noise draw and receive a second draw during training.
decisions.action: Cache clean simulator observations and add exactly one acquisition-noise draw per training batch; test single-noise input contract.

decisions.finding: 32 nonlinear posterior rollouts are compared with one deterministic parameter estimate.
decisions.action: Compare conditional flow against a four-component Gaussian-mixture posterior with matched 32-rollout prediction budget, alongside deterministic regression.

decisions.finding: The existing latent space assumes a cube, known patch faces and widths, force direction and initial state.
decisions.action: Do not apply the six-parameter cube checkpoint directly to arbitrary benchmark objects; qualify a geometry/controller-conditioned adapter separately.

decisions.finding: 600 SoftVTBench episodes exist locally; named prior artifacts cover only a subset.
decisions.action: Keep demos50-99 unopened as candidate fresh tests while development uses exposed episodes; audit exposure before sealing.

decisions.finding: PokeFlex raw data is absent; Deform360 preprocessing was explicitly paused.
decisions.action: Investigate legitimate PokeFlex acquisition; preserve Deform360 pause. Do not claim all datasets have been evaluated.

decisions.finding: Raw uncertainty is miscalibrated across forward discretizations.
decisions.action: Report cross-discretization prediction and coverage separately; calibrate on separate development worlds, never the test labels.

decisions.finding: Diagonal Gaussian mixture improves predictive errors and interval scores over flow on the synthetic confirmation; full covariance did not improve predictions.
decisions.action: Retain diagonal mixture as predictive candidate and flow as joint-uncertainty comparator; do not mandate flow or replace candidate with full covariance.

decisions.finding: Many SoftVT episodes are dominated by rigid motion; pastry002 task1 and PhysTwin push/stretch show more deformation.
decisions.action: Prioritize these exposed scenarios for mechanics development; preserve fresh episodes until protocol/checkpoints are frozen.

decisions.finding: Table support affects trajectories strongly; the sloth actually starts on a table. Convex-hull tetrahedra fill substantial empty space.
decisions.action: Retain explicit floor hypotheses and geometry-aware connected mesh gating; do not remove table support reflexively.

decisions.finding: Rebased tracking meshes are not the solved mechanical state; initial natural strain alone cannot provide a net supporting reaction.
decisions.action: Export raw mechanics separately from tracking maps. Add isolated objective initial strain and localized attachment-preload operators, not a cancelling body load.

decisions.finding: Impact results depend strongly on integration step; smooth dynamics tests pass but impacts are not admitted.
decisions.action: Keep existing simulation studies unchanged; do not use the new dynamic candidate for impact accuracy claims until unchanged convergence/energy gates pass.

decisions.finding: Native PhysTwin beats the new low-budget sloth pilot on matched evaluation points/masks; training budgets differ substantially. Better prefix fitting did not improve forecasting.
decisions.action: Preserve old best results; test informative exposed cases and direct bank retrieval before scaling the new inference network.

decisions.finding: Original sparse-mesh observation operator introduces 1.50–3.68 mm artificial coordinate error under a rigid 90-degree rotation across eight packages.
decisions.action: Create immutable affine-complete observation packages and regenerate training banks; never replace the observation map underneath an existing checkpoint.

decisions.finding: Randomized PCA was recomputed on resume; iid relative feature noise incorrectly perturbs frame zero and misses temporal covariance.
decisions.action: Version the driver; bind saved PCA, weights, bank and plan hashes; generate absolute-coordinate errors before shared frame-zero subtraction. Keep old experiments unchanged.

decisions.finding: Dense-surface sloth filter retains only 3 of 273 tetrahedra from sparse SoftVT volume points and is unsuitable for that representation.
decisions.action: Reject failed geometry explicitly; use declared convex-volume baseline for the bounded SoftVT pilot, with no silent filter fallback.

decisions.source: matched external pilots and retrieval audit
decisions.finding: On exposed SoftVT task1 demo0, flow tracking55.885mm barely beats nearest-bank56.891mm; pushedsloth mixture61.797mm is close to top8 retrieval61.176mm and worse than velocity36.341mm.
decisions.action: Do not scale density-model complexity; keep previous best external models. Treat neural inference gain and physical forward adequacy separately.

decisions.finding: Correctness fixes produce only small mixed changes: SoftVT mixture57.047→56.572mm and push mixture61.797→60.792mm; flow worsens. Both observed prefixes trigger discarded-feature mismatch screening.
decisions.action: Keep numerical/provenance corrections, not a new benchmark superiority claim. No physical posterior calibration claim outside supported bank/noise assumptions.

decisions.source: external structural audit and frozen pose-shape ablation
decisions.finding: Prototype omitted archived terminal pose/slip/release capabilities. Restoring pose alone improves pushing but no-impact free flight crosses the floor in SoftVT.
decisions.action: Reject global adoption of no-impact pose policy; evaluate a separately frozen archived contact continuation as a disclosed approximation, preserving failures and old best models.

decisions.source: separately frozen archived floor/contact continuation ablation
decisions.finding: Restoring archived transport/contact behavior reduces SoftVT raw flow56.22→18.31mm and mixture57.74→18.66mm. Pushedsloth still loses to velocity and has poor shape.
decisions.action: Keep as disclosed rigid/kinematic transport baseline alongside unchanged raw FEM, not a physical force/material recovery claim. Preserve failures and expand fixed comparisons before fresh confirmation.
